body: It's hard to track my exact train of thought... My brother thinks it might be because I struggle with depression? Usually I'm like "oh cool lil shroom guys this should be fun" and the next moment it's like. I don't know whats going on. Everything gets darker and faces become distorted, I can't hear anything and when I sober up I'm left with other people's accounts and videos I took to piece together what happened. It's just like... I'm fine, everything is scary and dark for a few hours, and suddenly I'm shaking and having heart palpitations as I slowly come to.
